title: Standards watchdog resumes Farage probe as rivals slam needless byelection

paragraphs.en: Nigel Farage’s attempt to draw the sting from inquiries into his financial affairs appeared to have backfired on Friday as the standards watchdog reopened its investigation and MPs from all sides condemned the needless byelection.
paragraphs.zh: 周五，奈杰尔·法拉奇试图为针对其财务问题的调查降温的做法似乎适得其反：标准监督机构重新展开调查，各党议员都谴责这场毫无必要的补选。

paragraphs.en: The Reform UK leader declared victory in the Clacton vote as he was returned with an increased majority and gained more votes than in 2024, saying he had “stuck two fingers up at the entire political establishment”.
paragraphs.zh: 这位英国改革党领袖在克拉克顿投票中宣布获胜，他以更高的多数票当选，得票数也比2024年更多，并表示他“向整个政治建制竖起了中指”。

paragraphs.en: However, parliament’s standards commissioner immediately reopened an investigation into whether he should have declared a series of gifts provided to him shortly before the last general election.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，议会标准专员立即重新启动了一项调查，调查他是否应申报在上次大选前不久收到的一系列馈赠。

paragraphs.en: These include a £5m personal gift from crypto billionaire Christopher Harborne , first revealed by the Guardian, and further financial support from his friend and convicted fraudster George Cottrell.
paragraphs.zh: 其中包括加密货币亿万富翁克里斯托弗·哈伯恩提供的500万英镑个人馈赠（此事最初由《卫报》披露），以及他的朋友、已被定罪的诈骗犯乔治·科特雷尔提供的进一步财务支持。

paragraphs.en: Rival parties said the reopening of the inquiry showed Farage’s attempt to avoid scrutiny had failed, with the Labour party chair, Bridget Phillipson, saying he now had “no hiding place” as he tries to “dodge and deflect” criticism.
paragraphs.zh: 其他政党表示，调查的重新启动表明，法拉奇逃避审查的企图已经失败。工党主席布里奇特·菲利普森表示，在他试图“躲避和转移”批评之际，他如今已“无处藏身”。

paragraphs.en: But at an event to celebrate his win, the Reform UK leader attempted to diminish the significance of the allegations under investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 但在庆祝自己获胜的活动中，这位英国改革党领袖试图淡化受调查指控的严重性。

paragraphs.en: He told GB News: “If I’ve made one sin, it’s that I haven’t filled in a piece of paper. I’ve broken no law, I’ve broken no tax law, I’ve taken no public money … maybe I haven’t filled in a piece of paper. I’m confident I’m right, let’s see where we go.”
paragraphs.zh: 他对GB新闻说：“如果我犯了一个过错，那就是我没有填一张表格。我没有违反任何法律，没有违反任何税法，没有拿过一分公款……也许我只是没填一张表格。我有信心我是对的，我们走着瞧。”

paragraphs.en: The scandal just keeps piling up. And now he’s through that byelection, there’s no hiding place
paragraphs.zh: 丑闻不断累积。现在他通过了那场补选，已经没有藏身之处了。
